title: Mid-career Entrants Taking Up Non-nursing Roles at Senior or Ageing Care Facilities via Government-funded Career Programmes
what_it_is: Mid-career Entrants Taking Up Non-nursing Roles at Senior or Ageing Care Facilities via Government-funded Career Programmes

sections.label: Mid-career entrants in community care
sections.summary: MOH does not track retention of mid-career entrants in non-nursing community care roles, and cites job redesign and salary guidelines to retain staff.

sentences.text: The following question stood in the name of Ms See Jinli Jean – 7 To ask the Minister for Health for each year over the last three years (a) what is the number of mid-career entrants who took up non-nursing roles at senior or ageing care facilities via Government-funded career programmes; (b) what is the retention rate of the mid-career entrants; and (c) what measures will the Ministry be introducing to improve the retention rate.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We do not track the retention rate for this group.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To retain staff, the Ministry of Health (MOH) and Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) have been working with community care organisations to implement job redesign, enhance the competitiveness of community care staff salaries and recently published salary guidelines which would help inform job seekers on the expected remuneration in community care roles.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Mr Pritam Singh, you have a supplementary question?

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I think the Prime Minister announced the expansion of Active Ageing Centres at his National Day Rally last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: And in view of what would be significant manpower requirements, is there a plan that the Ministry has to ramp up or mobilise this manpower and what sort of numbers are we looking at from the Ministry's standpoint?

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Indeed, manpower is an aspect that we have been monitoring quite closely, especially as we transform the efforts in the healthcare sector, in particular, with ageing.

sections.label: Statistics not available on hand
sections.summary: The speaker says the data is not on hand and suggests the Member file a separate Parliamentary Question.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: With regard to the statistics, Sir, I do not have the data on hand.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Perhaps the Member would want to file a separate Parliamentary Question on this.
